MIRA VALE TO MINA COLE. October 16, 1843
Dear colleague,
The east depot reported receiving the coastal dispatch
sent by Mina Cole in response to the request of October
13, 1843.

MINA COLE TO MIRA VALE. October 16, 1843
Dear colleague,
In response to that request of October 13, 1843, I, Mina
Cole, sent the coastal dispatch to the east depot.
Inventory leaf 1. The archive cupboard held a woolen cover beside an unrelated register. No dispatch is recorded here.
